name: s3GetMetaData
syntax: s3GetMetaData(bucketNameOrPath [, objectName, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Returns the metadata of an S3 bucket or object.

params.name: bucketNameOrPath
params.description: The bucket name, or an `s3://` path to a bucket or object, such as `s3://mybucket/file.txt`.

params.name: objectName
params.description: The object key, when `bucketNameOrPath` is a bucket name.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. Returns `content_type`, `content_length`, `etag`, `last_modified`, `storage_class` and any `x-amz-meta-*` headers. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: Get object metadata by bucket and key
examples.description: Returns a struct with the object's metadata.

examples.title: Get object metadata from a URL
examples.description: Passing an s3:// URL as the first argument addresses the object directly.
